notes: Official 2026 USMLE GI outline explicitly lists microscopic colitis, including collagenous and lymphocytic colitis.

Collagenous and Lymphocytic Colitis StatPearls last updated September 12, 2022 in the 2026 edition; watery nonbloody diarrhea, often normal colonoscopy, biopsy requirement and thickened collagen band directly supported.

duplicate_gate.selected_construct: Collagenous microscopic colitis with normal colonoscopy and diagnostic biopsy

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Older woman with chronic nocturnal watery nonbloody diarrhea, normal colonoscopy and a thickened subepithelial collagen band has collagenous colitis.
adversarial_second_pass.IBS_attack: IBS does not produce the diagnostic histologic collagen band and persistent nocturnal inflammatory diarrhea.
adversarial_second_pass.UC_attack: Ulcerative colitis usually has visible continuous mucosal inflammation and often blood.
adversarial_second_pass.celiac_attack: Celiac disease is a small-bowel villous disorder, not this colonic collagen-band lesion.
adversarial_second_pass.giardia_attack: Giardiasis lacks the defining colonic biopsy finding.

blueprint.competency: Patient Care: Diagnosis, including history and physical examination
